plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Git Workbench **把 Git 工作流带进 DeepSeek Harness。** 分支切换 · 变更审查 · 提交记录 · 储藏管理 · 多工作树 · AI 草稿协作 [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![CI](https://github.com/Yaronluo/dsh-plugin-git-workbench/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Yaronluo/dsh-plugin-git-workbench/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![DSH Plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek_Harness-Plugin-5865f2)](#安装) 在对话里写代码，在同一个工作区里看懂、整理并提交改动。 [快速开始](#安装) · [界面预览](#界面预览) · [参与贡献](CONTRIBUTING.md) · [反馈问题](https://github.com/Yaronluo/dsh-plugin-git-workbench/issues)
> 面向 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）Web GUI / Desktop 的社区开源插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方项目。插件依赖 DSH 宿主接口，不能作为独立网页运行；不同宿主版本的兼容性请以实际测试为准。 ## 为什么做这个插件？ AI 编程不止是生成代码，还需要审查差异、挑选提交、切换分支，以及用独立工作树并行探索。DSH Git Workbench 把这些操作放回当前会话，让你少切窗口，也更清楚每一次 Git 操作会影响什么。 ## 界面预览 以下五张图片均来自实际项目界面；截图中的仓库路径与提交记录仅作演示，外观可能随 DSH 版本和主题变化。 ### 分支入口：从输入框直接进入 Git 工作流 搜索与切换分支，快速获取、拉取、推送，或创建工作树开启新会话。 ![输入框上方的分支胶囊与快捷操作菜单](docs/screenshots/branch-menu.png) ### 变更工作台：专注当前仓库 与「对话 / 轨迹 / 上下文 / 编队」同排的 Git 页签；工作区干净时清晰呈现空状态，有改动时显示文件列表与差异。 ![Git 工作台变更页与干净工作区状态](docs/screenshots/changes.png)
提交记录：回看项目演进 浏览提交图谱、作者与引用，点开提交查看逐文件差异；也可切换到引用日志。 ![提交记录列表与分支引用](docs/screenshots/history.png)
储藏管理：暂存思路，稍后继续 保存未提交改动，查看补丁，再选择应用、弹出或删除。 ![储藏管理页及空状态](docs/screenshots/stash.png)
工作树管理：并行开发，各自独立 查看工作树状态、打开对应会话、在文件管理器中显示目录，以及锁定或安全移除工作树。 ![工作树列表与管理操作](docs/screenshots/worktrees.png)
## 核心能力 | 场景 | 能力 | | --- | --- | | 分支与同步 | 自动识别 Git 仓库，搜索和切换分支，创建分支，fetch / pull / push，上游与 ahead / behind 信息 | | 变更审查 | 按冲突、已暂存、未暂存、未跟踪分组；行号、词级高亮、并排差异、上下文与忽略空白 | | 精细提交 | 文件或 hunk 级暂存 / 取消暂存，提交草稿，amend、Signed-off-by、撤销上次提交 | | 历史追溯 | 提交图谱、提交详情、逐文件 diff、reflog、文件历史与 blame | | 储藏与工作树 | 储藏补丁预览与恢复；工作树创建、打开会话、锁定 / 解锁、清理预演 | | 冲突处理 | 冲突分组、选用当前 / 传入版本，以及进行中 Git 操作的继续 / 中止 / 跳过 | | 本机工具 | 在编辑器或文件管理器中打开文件、复制路径 / 补丁、仓库内图片预览 | | 会话协作 | 按会话与仓库保留选择、草稿和滚动位置；提供 8 个 agent Git 工具 | ### AI 帮忙，但由你决定何时发送 「AI 写信息」「AI 审查改动」「注入 Git 上下文」「解释这个文件」只准备提示词草稿： - 优先打开当前会话的右侧对话并追加草稿，不覆盖已有内容。 - 缺少可用侧边对话时，在同一项目目录新建普通对话并填入草稿。 - **不自动发送、不自动提交、不自动调用模型**；请先检查草稿再手动发送。 - 编写提交信息读取暂存区补丁；审查改动使用当前比较范围。 供 agent 使用的工具：`git_status`、`git_diff`、`git_log`、`git_stage`、`git_unstage`、`git_commit`、`git_stash`、`git_branch`。所有工具都需要明确的 `cwd`。 ## 安装 ### 环境要求 - 已安装并能运行的 DSH Web GUI / Desktop。插件清单声明 `dsh >=0.2.0-rc.2`，但这不代表所有后续版本都经过验证。 - 本机安装 Git，并确保 `git` 在 DSH 进程的 `PATH` 中可用。 - 从源码构建 / 运行测试：建议 **Node.js 24.2+**、**pnpm 11**。 ### npm 安装（推荐） npm 包名是 **`dsh-plugin-git-workbench`**，已包含构建产物，无需在本地编译。注意：npm 上的 `dsh-plugin-git` 是其他作者的包，并非本项目。 ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-plugin-git-workbench ``` ### GitHub Release 安装 也可直接安装 GitHub Release 提供的预构建包： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add https://github.com/Yaronluo/dsh-plugin-git-workbench/releases/latest/download/dsh-plugin-git-workbench.tgz ``` 其它 profile 请将 `desktop` 替换为实际名称。按宿主提示重启应用后使用。 ### 校验发布来源 `1.0.5` 起，npm 上的包由 GitHub Actions 通过 [npm Trusted Publishing](https://docs.npmjs.com/trusted-publishers)（OIDC）发布：仓库里不再保存长期 npm token，每次发布都由 runner 现场换取一次性凭据；npm 随之附上 **provenance 证明**，记录这个 tarball 由哪个仓库、哪个 workflow、哪个提交构建而来。 想确认手里的包确实来自本仓库，可以查它的证明： ```bash npm view dsh-plugin-git-workbench dist.attestations ``` 把包装进某个项目后，也可以让 npm 校验整棵依赖树的签名：`npm audit signatures`。只有 npm 渠道带证明；GitHub Release 的 tarball 由同一个 tag 触发构建、内容一致，但没有签名。`1.0.4` 及更早的版本是用一次性 token 发布的，没有 provenance。 ### 从源码安装 开发和本地调试可使用以下方式： ```bash git clone https://github.com/Yaronluo/dsh-plugin-git-workbench.git cd dsh-plugin-git-workbench pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts pnpm build ``` 然后将构建后的项目以本地 link 插件加入 DSH Desktop profile。将下面路径替换成你本机克隆目录的绝对路径： ```powershell dsh plugin --profile desktop add "link:D:\path\to\dsh-plugin-git-workbench" ``` 其它 profile 请将 `desktop` 替换为实际名称。安装后按 DSH 提示重启应用，再打开 Git 仓库中的会话，查看 Git 页签与输入框上方的分支入口。 > Host 代码变更需要重新加载插件或完整重启 DSH，单纯刷新网页不会替换正在运行的 Host 服务。客户端修改后也建议构建并刷新；不要假设所有安装方式都支持热更新。 ### 外部编辑器 默认探测 `code`、`cursor`、`code-insiders`、`windsurf`、`zed`、`subl`；也可通过启动 DSH 前设置的 `DSH_GIT_EDITOR` 指定编辑器可执行文件。路径含空格时请遵循所在 shell 的引用规则。插件优先使用宿主打开能力，必要时回退到本机应用。 ## 开发与测试 ```bash pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts pnpm typecheck pnpm test pnpm build ``` 测试使用 Node 内置测试运行器。Git 写操作测试在临时仓库中运行，不应操作你的真实工作仓库。依赖已安装 DSH / Chromium 的集成测试在环境缺失时会明确跳过；自动测试不等同于当前登录窗口已完成人工验收。 更多测试背景、环境变量与历史回归记录见 [TESTING.md](TESTING.md)。 ### 项目结构 ```text src/ ├── index.ts # Host 插件入口 ├── core/ # Git 命令、解析与共享类型 ├── host/ # Git 服务、HTTP/SSE、agent 工具与本机打开能力 └── client/ # React 工作台、分支胶囊、diff 与会话集成 scripts/ # Host / Client 构建脚本 tests/ # 单元、真实 Git 与可选宿主 / 浏览器回归 docs/screenshots/ # README 界面截图 lib/ # 已构建的插件产物 ``` ## 安全与使用边界 - 这是可以修改本地仓库的 Git 客户端，不是只读预览器。提交、恢复文件、软重置、储藏删除等操作前，请确认目标仓库与影响范围，重要工作先备份。 - 包含引用 / 路径校验、字面路径处理、冲突守卫与危险操作确认；这些保护不能替代代码审查，也不构成安全保证。 - AI 草稿可能包含代码、路径和差异。发送前请移除密钥和不应交给所选模型服务的内容。 - 凭据由本机 Git 配置及凭据管理器处理，不要把 token 放入仓库或问题反馈中。 - 漏洞报告方式见 [SECURITY.md](SECURITY.md)。 ## 参与贡献 欢迎提交问题、兼容性反馈、文档改进和 Pull Request。请提供 DSH / 系统 / Git 版本及可复现步骤；涉及代码或截图时先脱敏。开始前请阅读 [贡献指南](CONTRIBUTING.md)。 ## 许可证 本项目代码采用 [MIT License](LICENSE)，Copyright © 2026 Yaronluo。 截图用于展示插件在 DSH 中的集成效果；DeepSeek、DSH 及相关标识归各自权利人所有，代码许可证不授予第三方品牌或商标权。

plugins.description: A Skills page for the DSH Web GUI: every skill DSH can see, grouped All · Global · Workspaces, with search, copy-command, per-skill origin, and the roots DSH discovers skills from.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-managers

A **Skills** page for the DSH Web GUI — its own sidebar entry beside *Plugins*, listing every skill
DSH can see, grouped **All · Global · Workspaces**, with search, copy-command, per-skill origin, and
the roots DSH discovers skills from.

## Why

The page exists because DSH shows a cold session almost none of your skills, and the reason is
structural rather than a bug.

The client reaches skills through `skills/list` — a **session-addressed** Remote. DSH deliberately
keeps filesystem discovery out of the host layer:

```yaml
# dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml
# the base host `skill-filesystem` row is disabled here (presets own local discovery)
- id: skill-filesystem
  disabled: true
```

So `~/.dsh/skills` and `<workspace>/.dsh/skills` exist only inside a **live agent's** preset scope. A
cold session falls back to the global layer, which carries no filesystem provider:

```js
// dsh-api-session-controller/lib/types/skill-catalog.js
const scoped = live === undefined ? undefined : presets?.serviceFor(live, 'skills');
const skillRegistry = scoped ?? this.ctx.get('skills');   // ← cold session
```

The first version of this page therefore showed four pathless entries — three Office skills plus a
plugin-registered one — and **nothing** from `~/.dsh/skills`.

The fix is not to view per session. It is to **register a global provider** that scans the roots
itself. Because the catalog falls back to the global layer, every session then sees the complete set,
and the browser half is free to present categories rather than sessions. The session remains only as
transport.

## Quick Start

The plugin installs into your DSH **profile** by link — it is not published to npm, so the clone is
the source. Both routes end with a **restart**.

### Option A — the script

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-skill-managers.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-skill-managers
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-skill-managers
./install.sh                 # builds, registers in your profile, runs pnpm install
```

It accepts `--profile <dir>` to target a profile other than `~/.dsh/profiles/desktop`, `--check` to
report what would change without writing anything, and `--remove` to unregister.

### Option B — the manual steps

**1. Clone it somewhere stable** (this path becomes your install path):

```bash
git clone https://github.com/mrdhira/dsh-skill-managers.git ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-skill-managers
cd ~/.dsh/plugins/dsh-skill-managers
```

**2. Build it.** `pnpm install` runs the `prepare` script, which builds `lib/**` — the part DSH
actually loads. It is generated; never hand-edit it.

```bash
pnpm install
```

**3. Register it with your profile** — the dependency and the bundle name, with an absolute path:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-skill-managers": "link:/Users/<you>/.dsh/plugins/dsh-skill-managers"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "dsh-skill-managers"
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

**4. Install the link, then restart DSH:**

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && pnpm install
```

Nothing needs adding to `cordis.patch.yml`: the bundle declares its own Loader row.

> **Restart, don't reload.** The host half loads once per app process, so a host-side change needs a
> full quit and reopen (`⌘Q`, then reopen). A page reload does not pick it up. A client-side (UI)
> change needs the bundle toggled in the plugin manager.

### Verify it is really working

A **Skills** entry should appear in the sidebar beside *Plugins*, listing your skills. If it does
not:

- `lib/v1/index.js` exists — if not, `pnpm install` did not finish building;
- the profile's `package.json` names `dsh-skill-managers` in **both** `dependencies` and
  `dsh.profile.bundles`;
- DSH was **restarted** after installing.

Two ways to see it clearly:

```bash
# the host half answers with its Loader identity
node -e "import('./lib/v1/index.js').then(m => console.log(m.name))"   # dsh-skill-managers

# what the page will list, straight from the roots (no DSH needed)
find ~/.dsh/skills ~/.agents/skills -maxdepth 2 -name SKILL.md 2>/dev/null
```

### Configure

**There is nothing to configure.** The plugin reads the catalog the host already serves through the
existing `skills/list` Remote, and scans the roots below on its own. No settings, no patch fields —
its whole surface is the page.

What it scans, ranked to mirror `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` so a duplicate name resolves the
same way it does inside a preset:

| Rank | Root | Source |
|---|---|---|
| 100 | `<workspace>/.dsh/skills` | `project-dsh` |
| 200 | `<workspace>/.agents/skills` | `project-agents` |
| 400 | `~/.dsh/skills` | `user-dsh` |
| 500 | `~/.agents/skills` | `user-agents` |
| 600 | shipped with the app | `bundled` (app providers) |

Workspaces come from the live `workspaces` service, so a new workspace appears without a code change
or a restart.

## How it Works

The host half registers one **global** skill provider that scans the roots above. The browser half
renders the catalog through two slot contributions under the key `skills`: a `sidebar.panellist`
entry (the sidebar item, drawing between *Plugins* at 0 and *Automation tasks* at 10), and a `main`
panel that receives its services through `inject`.

```
┌ Skills ─────────────────────────────────── [ search ]  [ Refresh ]
│ 17 skills · 4 in a workspace
│
│  All 17   Global 13   Workspaces 4
│
│  WORKSPACE · default-workspace                    4
│  workspace  /caveman                                    [ Copy ]
│  Terse caveman voice: answer first, fluff gone.         ▶ show path
│
│  GLOBAL                                          13
│  global  /ponytail                                      [ Copy ]
│  Forces the laziest solution that actually works.       ▶ show path
│
│  BUNDLED                                          3
│  bundled  /office-docx                                  [ Copy ]
└──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

| Category | What it shows |
|---|---|
| **All** | Everything the provider found, grouped by origin |
| **Global** | `~/.dsh/skills`, `~/.agents/skills`, bundled, and other non-project roots |
| **Workspaces** | Skills under each registered workspace's `.dsh/skills` / `.agents/skills` |

### Origins

`skills/list` returns only `{ name, path?, description, whenToUse?, modelInvocable }` — `source`,
`provider` and `resourceBase` are stripped. Origin is therefore derived from the path, with one
honest exception: a skill whose provider supplies no path (bundled Office, or a `skills.register()`
call) is labelled **bundled** rather than implying an error.

| Label | Matched when |
|---|---|
| `workspace` | the path is under a registered workspace |
| `global` | the path contains `/.dsh/skills/` or `/.agents/skills/` |
| `bundled` | no path, or a shipped root (`dsh-agent-preset/skills`, `office-skills`) |
| `other` | anywhere else |

### Requirements

- **DSH** with the Web GUI, and a profile you can edit (`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/`).
- **Node.js 22+** and **pnpm** to build from source. The built artifact needs nothing extra at
  runtime.

### Development

```bash
pnpm install        # deps + build (prepare)
pnpm build          # src/** -> lib/v1/**
pnpm typecheck      # three projects: host, browser half, tests
pnpm test           # builds first, then runs the suite (25 tests)
```

```
src/host/index.ts     the global skill provider that scans the discovery roots -> lib/v1/index.js
src/client/index.cts  sidebar entry, page, categories, catalog fetch          -> lib/v1/client.js
types/dsh.d.ts        observed (not published) DSH contract declarations
test/host.test.ts     provider coverage against real temp trees
test/client.test.ts   jsdom + React coverage of the page
test/harness.ts       the shared jsdom realm and mount helpers
test/build.test.ts    the freshness gate: artifacts exist, mirror src, are not stale
build.mjs             esbuild: host ESM unbundled, client CJS + loader handshake
cordis.patch.yml      the one Loader row the bundle contributes
```

`src/client/index.cts` is CommonJS to both esbuild and tsc (`.cts`), because the loader's factory
returns `module.exports`; `build.mjs

plugins.description: Expose a running DeepSeek Harness instance over MCP, so an external agent can list, delegate to, and answer questions in that instance's own sessions.
plugins.readme_text:
![dsh-mcp-relay](assets/banner.gif)

# dsh-mcp-relay

[English](README.md) | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Expose a running [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) instance over the
[Model Context Protocol](https://modelcontextprotocol.io), so an external agent — Codex, or any MCP client —
can drive that instance's own sessions.

A DSH session behaves like a subagent from the caller's point of view: it keeps its own context across calls,
works in the workspace you name, and returns a final answer. The relay also lets the caller answer the
questions that DSH agent asks, so a delegated task never deadlocks waiting for a human who is not there.

## Why

Driving a DSH instance through its web GUI from another agent costs a screenshot or DOM round trip per step.
This relay replaces that with a small structured API: one tool call in, one result out.

## Architecture

```
MCP client (stdio)
 └── bin/dsh-mcp-relay.mjs          MCP server; polls the relay, holds questions for the caller
      └── HTTP 127.0.0.1:<port>/dsh-relay
           └── lib/index.js    host Cordis plugin mounted inside the running DSH process
                └── ctx.sessionController → DSH agent
```

Two halves, and the split matters:

- **`lib/index.js`** is a DSH host plugin. It runs in the same process as the Web GUI, so it can read and
  write the sessions that instance already has. It registers an HTTP route and does the DSH work.
- **`bin/dsh-mcp-relay.mjs`** is a standalone MCP server that speaks stdio to your agent and HTTP to the plugin.
  It exists because DSH's own process owns stdout, so the plugin cannot serve stdio itself.

Waiting and polling happen in the MCP server, where they cost nothing; your model spends one tool call and
receives the finished result.

## Requirements

- DSH with a Web profile (`dsh web` or the desktop app).
- Node.js 18 or newer on the same machine as DSH.
- An MCP client that can spawn a stdio server.

## Install the plugin

Install straight from this repository — the package is not published to npm:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Nigheart/dsh-mcp-relay
```

Then restart DSH. On startup the log should show:

```
[dsh-mcp-relay] mounted /dsh-relay (tokenRequired=false)
```

Verify it independently:

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-relay/ping
# {"ok":true,"data":{"relay":"dsh-mcp-relay","version":"0.6.0","tokenRequired":false}}
```

If your instance listens on a port other than 3080, use that port here and set `DSH_RELAY_URL` for the MCP
server (below).

### Manual install

If you prefer to wire it up by hand, add the package to the profile's `package.json` and list it as a bundle:

```json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-mcp-relay": "github:Nigheart/dsh-mcp-relay" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app", "dsh-mcp-relay"] } }
}
```

The package ships its own `cordis.patch.yml`, which inserts one loader row. That row declares
`inject: [webServer, sessionController]` — keep it. Without `inject` the plugin can be activated before those
services exist, find nothing to bind to, and mount no route at all.

## Configure your MCP client

Codex (`~/.codex/config.toml`):

```toml
[mcp_servers.dsh]
command = "node"
args = ["/absolute/path/to/dsh-mcp-relay/bin/dsh-mcp-relay.mjs"]
startup_timeout_sec = 60

# Only needed when DSH is not on the default port, or when a token is set.
[mcp_servers.dsh.env]
DSH_RELAY_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8080/dsh-relay"
```

The server sends its own usage notes in the MCP handshake (`initialize.instructions`), so the client learns
the workflow without any extra prompting.

Environment variables:

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `DSH_RELAY_URL` | `http://127.0.0.1:3080/dsh-relay` | Where the plugin listens. |
| `DSH_RELAY_TOKEN` | *(unset)* | Sent as `x-dsh-relay-token`; must match the plugin's value. |
| `DSH_RELAY_TIMEOUT_MS` | `600000` | Default wait for one delegated turn. |
| `DSH_RELAY_POLL_MS` | `2000` | Progress poll interval. |

## Tools

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `dsh_list_sessions` | List sessions of the running instance, optionally filtered to one workspace. |
| `dsh_models` | List the provider/model ids this instance can route, with each model's reasoning efforts. |
| `dsh_delegate` | Create a session in a workspace, or continue one by `sessionId`, send an instruction, and wait for that turn to finish. |
| `dsh_answer` | Answer a question the DSH agent asked, so it can resume. |
| `dsh_approval` | Choose how a session resolves **future** approval requests: `gui`, `auto-approve`, or `deny`. |
| `dsh_cancel` | Cancel the active turn — the way out of an approval nobody can answer. |
| `dsh_poll` | Read a session's status and latest output; use after a wait that returned `waiting` or `timeout`. |

### Delegating work

```
dsh_delegate({ workspace: "/home/me/project", instruction: "Add the missing tests for parser.js" })
```

Omit `sessionId` to start a new DSH agent; pass the returned `sessionId` back to continue the **same** agent,
which still remembers the earlier work. `status` tells you what happened:

| `status` | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `completed` | The turn finished; `output` holds the agent's final answer. |
| `waiting` | Blocked on a human: either a question takeover is holding for you, or an open approval request. |
| `timeout` | Still running; call `dsh_poll` with the same `baselineSeq`. |

The relay also attaches every session it creates (or reuses) to the DSH workspace owning the target
directory. DSH groups sessions in its GUI by that explicit attachment rather than by working directory, so
without it a delegated session runs fine but shows up as *ungrouped*. Sessions created before this behaviour
existed can be repaired with one call to the relay's `POST /dsh-relay/attach-all` endpoint.

### Choosing the model

A session runs on the instance's default model unless you say otherwise. `dsh_models` reports what this
instance can route right now — provider groups, model ids, and each model's reasoning efforts:

```
dsh_models()
dsh_delegate({ workspace: "/home/me/project", instruction: "…",
               model: "deepseek-v4.1-pro", reasoningEffort: "high" })
```

`model` takes a model id; `provider` is inferred when that id is unambiguous, and `provider/model` is
always accepted. `reasoningEffort` must be one of the efforts `dsh_models` lists for that model. A route
this instance cannot serve fails the call *before* the instruction is sent, rather than quietly running
it on some other model.

The selection applies to this turn and is also saved as the instance default for sessions created
without one — the same stickiness DSH's own model picker has, so choose deliberately. Omit `model` to
leave the session on whatever it already uses. `dsh_delegate` echoes the selection it installed as
`model` (with `modelNote`); `dsh_list_sessions` and `dsh_poll` report each session's current `model`,
read from DSH's model-selection projection (a hint: it is `null` until the session has recorded a
request, and on deployments without that projection).

### Answering questions

By default a delegated session runs under **takeover**: when the DSH agent calls its question tool, the call is
suspended and handed to the caller instead of the GUI. `dsh_delegate` then returns immediately with the
question rather than waiting:

```json
{
  "status": "waiting",
  "waiting": {
    "kind": "user-question",
    "toolName": "ask_user_question",
    "intercepted": true,
    "detail": [{ "id": "choice", "question": "Which database?", "options": ["sqlite", "postgres"] }]
  }
}
```

Answer it with the ids from `detail`:

```
dsh_answer({ sessionId, answers: [{ id: "choice", selected: ["sqlite"] }] })
```

If nobody answers within about three minutes, the question falls back to the DSH GUI, so an unattended
delegation cannot hang forever. Pass `takeover: false` to `dsh_delegate` to leave questions with the GUI from
the start.

### Approvals

Some operations need a decision before DSH will run them — for example escalating a sandbox so a tool can write
outside the session workspace. The session then reports:

plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

Normify · 归一化框架图构建器

把整个项目描述成一棵"人机共读"的分形模块树：AI 负责分析与创作，确定性引擎负责校验、编译与渲染 —— 点开任意模块，就是一张更精细的子图。

--- ## 0. 一句话 Normify 是 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）插件**，也是**一套写给 AI 用的开发流程**： - **给 AI 的**：`normify-gen` 技能 + **31 个 `normify_*` 工具** —— 让模型把仓库分析成模块树结构数据， 并在后续开发中**先建图后编程、伴随编程改图**（计划态建树 → 逐个实现 → 关单收尾）。 - **给引擎的**：零容忍校验（L1 写时 / L2 全项目 / L3 冻结）+ 确定性编译（`tree.json` 等四件产物，SHA-256 冻结） + 渲染数据（`renders/`，决定"每一层怎么画"）。 - **给人的**：**单文件交互式架构图**（`normify.html`）—— 逐层下钻、悬停看介绍、一键中英切换、深链接、 多树、**API 直连箭头**、跨层聚合、缩放与搜索。零依赖，双击即开。 > 它不是"生成一张图就结束"的工具：结构数据与代码**互为契约**，每次改动都能被 `normify_sync` 检出漂移， > 并以 `normify_change_close`（**0 error 强制**）收尾，让"代码 → 架构图"永远同步。


引擎层：14 个模块、API 直连箭头（箭头锚定到具体 API 行）、带标签的子系统依赖、跨层聚合虚线

## 1. 它解决什么问题 | 痛点 | Normify 的做法 | | --- | --- | | 架构图一画完就过期 | 结构数据是**可校验的源数据**：`normify_sync` 按 `fingerprint` 检出漂移，`normify_change_close` 强制 0 error 收尾 | | 图太粗，看不出接口契约 | 粒度到**单一功能单元**，API 写在叶子上，箭头可锚定到具体 API（`from_api`/`to_api`） | | AI 改代码时"看不见全局" | `normify_brief` 给出目标模块契约、影响面（谁依赖我）、规则约束与验收清单 | | 设计先写代码后补文档，必然漂移 | **计划态先建树**（`state: planned`）→ 实现后 `normify_module_refresh(activate)` 自动转 active | | 结构规范靠人自觉 | `policy.yml` 架构规则（依赖方向 / 禁依赖 / 无环 / 深度 / 跨树 / 命名）由 `validate` 强制执行 | | 大仓库一次生成太重 | 增量再生成：只重建受影响子树，`layouts_to_review` 点名要复核的层 | ## 2. 核心特性 ### 2.1 数据模型：分形 + 零冗余 - **唯一元素**：整个数据库由无数个结构完全相同的**基本模块**构成（每个模块 = 一个 Markdown 文件）。 - **只存 `parent`**：单方向引用，`children` 由索引导出 —— 不会出现"父子各说各话"。 - **API 只在叶子存一次**：聚合、统计、索引全部是编译期派生数据（`tree.json` / `api-index.json`）。 - **两类边**：containment（树边，导航骨架）+ dependency（箭头，可跨子树、跨树，按 `kind` 着色）。 - **路径式 id + 不变 uid**：AI 沿 id 逐层定位（类二分查找）；`uid` 在改名/移动时保持不变，git diff 稳定。 - **深度不设上限**（0.5.0 起）：想有多细就拆多细，深度不再成为"合并模块"的理由。 ### 2.2 三层校验，fail-closed | 层 | 时机 | 内容 | | --- | --- | --- | | **L1** | 每次写入 | 必填字段、id 文法、uid、parent 一致性、双语长度、source/apis/deps 形状、state/replacement | | **L2** | `normify_validate` | 全项目：唯一性、文件↔id 映射、叶子/非叶子规则、API 键唯一、依赖目标、环、渲染数据交叉校验、架构规则、变更日志、（可选）仓库证据（source 存在性 + 指纹一致） | | **L3** | `normify_build` | 任何 error 都不产出产物；产出即 SHA-256 冻结进 `receipt.json` | 每条诊断都带 `severity / code / message / subject / evidence / supportedFixes` —— **AI 可自行修复**。 ### 2.3 渲染器：单文件、可下钻、API 直连 - 单文件 HTML（内联 CSS/JS，**零外部依赖**、零遥测），双击即开，可直接归档/发人。 - 逐层下钻 + 面包屑 + 搜索（模块名/API）+ 大纲视图 + API 浏览器。 - **API 直连**：叶子框内展示 API 明细行，箭头锚定到具体 API 行的端口；同一 API 行上的多条边自动扇形分离。 - 跨层依赖聚合为虚线 `×N`（默认隐藏，工具栏或 `?agg=1` 开启，悬停看明细）。 - 深链接：`#module=`、`#api=`、`#view=outline`、`?lang=zh|en`、`?agg=1`；缩放 / 悬停高亮 / 明暗主题。 - **几何自检**：仓库自带 `check-geometry.mjs`，逐层断言"线不出界 / 不贴框 / 不穿框 / 不压线"。 ### 2.4 伴随开发：先建图后编程 ``` change_open → brief → check → module_batch(state=planned) → 【写代码】 → module_refresh(activate) → change_close(0 error 强制) → verified + revision.after ``` - **计划态**：源码还不存在也能先建树（`fingerprint: pending`），`validate` 放行； - **禁止假激活**：源码没落地就 `activate` 直接被拒； - **收尾即闭环**：`change_close` 会刷新指纹 → 校验（0 error 强制）→ 编译（可选渲染）→ 标记 `verified`， 任何一步失败都不关闭，变更保持原状态； - **改图随代码**：`normify_sync` 用 `git diff` + 未跟踪文件定位受影响模块与指纹漂移，`module_patch` 跟随更新。 ### 2.5 架构规则先行（policy.yml） | 规则 | 作用 | | --- | --- | | `dependency-direction` | 层顺序即允许的依赖方向（如 plugin → tools → engine），可控制同层是否允许 | | `forbid-dependency` | 禁止某些 from → to 的依赖（可按 kind / state 过滤） | | `acyclic` | 依赖图禁止成环（可含跨树） | | `max-depth` | id 段数上限（**可选**：不写就是不限，0.5.0 起默认不限） | | `cross-tree` | 跨树依赖策略：`forbid` / `allow` / `require-to-api` | | `naming` | 作用域内 id 段的命名正则 | 安装后 `normify_validate` / `normify_build` / `normify_check` 全部强制执行；**违规先改设计，不能绕过**。 ## 3. 最新变化 ### v0.5.4 · 把"第二轮 A/B 实测"暴露的 4 个工具缺陷修掉（当前版本） 第二轮 A/B 换了题目（**表格公式引擎 + CLI**，同一份规范、隐藏黑盒 88 项、外加**差分模糊测试**）。 两组最终 B 88/88、A 87/88（差异只有一条 §5.2 语义）；这一版修的是**工具侧**新暴露的 4 个坑： - **`mode:"patch"` 的静默 no-op 被拦下**：原来 `items:[{patch:{id, tags:[...]}}]`（少一层包装）会返回 `ok:true, count:1` 却**一个字段都没改**——最危险的"假成功"。现在直接报 `args/invalid-patch`， evidence 里给出收到的键与正确形状 `{patch:{id, patch:{...}}}`；单模块 `normify_module_patch` 传空补丁 同样报 `args/empty-patch`（只给 `expect_updated_at` 也不再静默通过）。 - **`normify_module_refresh` 不再强依赖 git**：`repoRoot` 不是 git 仓库时，以前直接 `refresh/git-failed` 失败（实测中 AI 只能 `git init` 才能激活模块）。现在改成**降级**：指纹照常重算、 `state` 照常激活，`revision` 保持模块原值，并给出 `refresh/git-unavailable` 警告与修法。 - **`change_open` 的 `acceptance` 报错具体化**：以前把 `{zh,en}` 写进 acceptance 只有一句笼统报错； 现在明确写出"**第 N 条不是非空字符串（收到 …）：验收标准只接受纯字符串**"，并提示双语描述写进 `title`/`intent`。 - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic:"tool:<工具名>"`**：`tools` 主题现在每个工具都带**必填/可选**摘要， 新主题可按需打印**完整参数树**（类型 / 描述 / 必填，由注册表实时生成、与运行时校验同源）。 实测里 AI 为确认 `mode=patch` 的嵌套形状去读了插件源码——这条主题正是为了消灭这种绕路。 ### v0.5.3 · 把「伴随编程实测」暴露的 4 个摩擦点修掉 这四个问题来自一次真实的 A/B 对照实验：两个 AI 用同一份规范写同一个后端，一个带插件走伴随流程、一个纯手写 （最终代码在隐藏黑盒验收上都是 **42/42**）。插件组多交付了 41 模块 / 110 API / 10 层的结构数据，但也踩到了下面 4 个坑： - **`normify_help` 支持 `topic`**：此前它完全忽略入参，只返回同一份字段速查 —— 实测里 AI 为了拿准 `change_open` / `layout_upsert` / `change_close` 的参数名，只能去读插件源码（多花约 4 分钟）。 现在按主题返回：`fields`（默认）/ `deps`（箭头与 API 直连）/ `renders` / `flow`（伴随流程）/ `tools`（工具清单）/ `policy` / `errors`（常见诊断码与修法）/ `all`；**传错主题会直接报错并列出可用主题**，不再静默忽略。 - **项目初始化通道**：新增第 31 个工具 `normify_project_init` —— 建 `normify-/` + 默认架构规则， 可选 `root` 一步创建"计划态根模块"（幂等）；同时 `normify_change_open` 现在也会**自动建项目目录** （此前报 `project/no-modules`，AI 只能用 `module_batch {items:[],dry_run:true}` 绕过去）； `normify_brief` 遇到不存在的模块会给出"先 init / 先建树 / 改用 task"的可执行提示。 - **批量诊断的因果链**：一条 `label-too-long` 曾连带出 3 条 `dep/target-missing`（因为 L1 失败的模块会被移出批次工作集）， AI 只能去读源码才能确认根因。现在连带错误改报 `dep/target-dropped` / `structure/parent-dropped`， 在 message 与 evidence 里点明**根因诊断码**，并在失败响应的 `root_causes` 里直接列出被丢弃的模块（附 `hint`）。 - **「API 直连」引导**：两端都声明了 API 却没写 `from_api` / `to_api` 的箭头，`normify_validate` 会给出**聚合** warning `dep/unanchored`（条数 + 前 3 条示例）。这正是实验里被浪费的能力：110 条 API 声明，54 条箭头 0 条锚定 —— 不锚定，箭头就只能落在框边，钉不到 API 行上。**引导≠放宽**：锚错键仍然是 error。 ### v0.5.2 · 修掉三处会写坏数据的真实缺陷 - **`normify_module_upsert` 的必填表不再丢失**：`parameters.required` 恢复为 `["frontmatter"]`， `frontmatter` 的 9 个必填字段（uid / id / parent / name / description / source / revision / updated_at / fingerprint） 也重新出现在 schema 里。此前嵌套 schema 被二次编译，必填表被整段丢掉 —— 模型看到的约束与运行时实际校验不一致。 - **`normify_module_move` 迁移渲染数据时重写内容**：`id` / `order` / `groups.children` / `edge_hints` 全部改写到新 id， 并同步维护**旧父级**（删掉已迁出子模块的引用）与**新父级**（把新 id 补进 `order`）。 修复前：move 完之后项目立刻被 L2 判为 `layout/id-mismatch` + `layout/order-child` 等（实测 8–9 个 error，0.5.2 后为 0）。 - **晋升为容器时不再把 API 留在容器上**：叶子被晋升（显式 `normify_module_promote`、写子模块自动晋升、move 到叶子底下） 时，容器上残留的 `apis` 会被摘除，并回报 `structure/api-dropped-on-promote` 警告（附丢失的 API 键清单）—— 修复前项目会直接卡在 `api/non-leaf`。 - **API 默认全展开**：渲染数据字段 `max_api_rows` 缺省 **0 = 全部展开**，叶子上的 API 一行不折叠；需要收窄时显式写 1..48。 - 三处缺陷各自配了回归断言：`tests/regression-0.5.2.mjs`（34 项，全绿）。 ### v0.5.1 · 渲染器防重叠（线压线 12 → 0） - **修复连线共线重叠**：28 层合计 **12 处 → 0 处**。四处根因： ① 首选路由只判"不穿别人的框"，从不检查是否压到已画的线 → 改为只接受 `violations === 0` 的候选； ② API 锚定端口没有端口分离（同一 API 行被多条边共用） → 行内 ±5.5px 扇形分离； ③ API 端口落在上下边时被放进框内部 → 上下边退回按边均匀分离； ④ `segClear` 整块跳过源/目标框 → 新增"进入自身框内部"检查（内缩 2px）。 - 节点/分组间距 170 → 220，给密集层更多自由通道。 ### v0.5.0 · 取消模块数量上限 - **删除 `MAX_DEPTH = 12`** 硬限制：树可以一直下钻到"单一功能单元"；需要限层时用 `policy.yml` 的 `max-depth` 规则显式声明（`maxDepth` 放宽到 1..64）。 - SKILL：目标深度改为"不设上限"，单批上限 40 → 200，新增"每叶 API 尽量 3–5 条"的粒度指引。

# opencode2dsh **Free OpenCode Zen models, natively inside DSH (DeepSeek Harness).** No API key. No registration. No extra process. [![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin) [![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/@opencode2dsh%2Fdsh-plugin)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/blob/master/LICENSE) [![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A520-brightgreen)](https://nodejs.org) [![DeepSeek Harness](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-blue)](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh) English | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)
--- opencode2dsh registers a native DSH `LlmAdapter` that streams directly from [OpenCode Zen](https://opencode.ai/zen)'s **anonymous free lane** — the same models OpenCode's own CLI uses without an account, served to your DSH model picker as a regular provider called `opencode2dsh`. Requests leave your machine looking exactly like traffic from the OpenCode CLI (same user agent, same correlation headers), and the model catalog stays fresh through a three-tier fallback chain. There is nothing to log into and nothing to host. ## Highlights - **Zero credential, zero setup** — the anonymous lane needs no key; install, restart, chat - **Native adapter, no sidecar** — one npm package, no child process, no binary, no local port (the legacy Go sidecar is not part of the published package; see `legacy/`) - **CLI-identical disguise** — requests carry the OpenCode CLI user agent and its session/request/project header set, derived per conversation - **Selectable thinking levels** — reasoning-capable free models expose an effort picker in DSH's model selector (declared ladders where the model metadata provides them, Off/Minimal/Low/Medium/High otherwise); Responses-only `muse-spark-*` models expose only upstream-supported effort levels, and no selection keeps the provider default - **Image input where it is declared** — image attachments are accepted for every model whose [models.dev](https://models.dev) entry lists `image` in `modalities.input`, and refused for the ones that declare `text` only; models.dev being silent falls back to the live-verified vision family - **Live catalog with a fallback chain** — live upstream list ∩ free-by-metadata, falling back to offline cache and a verified static list - **Self-healing** — fast startup retries, periodic refresh, and a written health snapshot for diagnostics - **Proper error surfaces** — upstream failures (rate limit, auth, timeout, transport) arrive in DSH as classified finish reasons, and retries stay owned by DSH ## Install **From the plugin market** (recommended, once this repo is listed there): in DSH open **Settings → Plugin Market**, search `opencode2dsh`, one-click install. **From npm**: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin ``` **From source** (build the tarball yourself): ```sh git clone https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh.git cd opencode2dsh/packages/plugin pnpm install && pnpm pack dsh plugin --profile web add ./opencode2dsh-dsh-plugin-.tgz ``` **Verify**: restart `dsh web`, open the model picker, and pick a model from the **opencode2dsh** group. Requires DSH (DeepSeek Harness) 0.1.7 or newer with a web profile (the IP 池 settings page rides the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract); Node.js ≥ 20 (already present if DSH runs); outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` and `models.dev`. ## Configuration Defaults work out of the box. Override via the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`: ```yaml - id: opencode2dsh name: '@opencode2dsh/dsh-plugin' config: mode: adapter # adapter (default) | sidecar providerId: opencode2dsh refreshSeconds: 300 # catalog refresh cadence ``` | Option | Default | Description | | --- | --- | --- | | `mode` | `adapter` | `adapter`: native LlmAdapter streaming straight from Zen. `sidecar`: legacy local-agent mode, not bundled — build the agent from `legacy/agent` and pass `agentPath`. | | `providerId` | `opencode2dsh` | Provider name shown in DSH. | | `refreshSeconds` | `300` | Live catalog refresh interval. Pricing metadata refreshes every 24 h. | | `agentPath` | auto-resolved | Sidecar only: path to the agent binary. | | `agentArgs` | — | Sidecar only: extra CLI args for the agent. | | `restartDelayMs` / `restartMaxDelayMs` / `maxConsecutiveCrashes` | `1000` / `60000` / `5` | Sidecar only: restart backoff and circuit breaker. | | `firstEventMs` / `bodyIdleMs` / `responsesBodyIdleMs` | `30000` / `120000` / `300000` | Adapter only, plugin 0.3.7+: stream-liveness watchdogs, in ms (integers from `1` to `600000`). Time to the first stream event, mid-response body silence, and the body-idle floor for Responses models (`muse-spark-*`). Increase `firstEventMs` for slow cold starts. Unset keeps the defaults; restart DSH after editing. | ## How it works ``` DSH session │ harness chunks (block-start / text-delta / usage / finish …) ▼ ZenAdapter (registered LlmAdapter) │ pi-ai openai-completions stream (chat models) │ pi-ai openai-responses stream (`muse-spark-*`, Responses-only on Zen) ▼ https://opencode.ai/zen/v1 ← Authorization: Bearer public with CLI-identical headers: user-agent: opencode/… x-opencode-client, x-opencode-session, x-session-affinity, X-Session-Id, x-opencode-request, x-opencode-project ``` - **Session correlation** — session/project ids are SHA-256 derived from the conversation's first user turn (stable per conversation, non-reversible), and each request gets a fresh random id, mirroring the CLI. - **Catalog fallback chain** — S1: live `GET /v1/models`; S2: models.dev pricing metadata decides "free"; S3: a compile-time verified static list. A disk cache (~7-day TTL) covers upstream outages. - **Resilience** — the adapter registers immediately at startup; if the first catalog fetch races your network (VPN/TUN reconnects, DNS), the plugin retries on a short cadence (~1 min) before settling into the periodic refresh. - **Sidecar mode** (`mode: sidecar`, legacy) — spawns a local Go agent (a single-tenant port of [opencode2api](https://github.com/jasonxu114514/opencode2api)) on `127.0.0.1:`, token-authenticated, and registers a standard `llm-pi-ai` route. **Not part of the published package**; build it from `legacy/agent` (`go build ./cmd/agent`) and point `agentPath` at the binary. ## Health & troubleshooting The plugin writes a health snapshot after every refresh round: ``` ~/.opencode2dsh/adapter-status.json ``` ```json { "status": "ready", "total": 64, "exposed": 9, "lastError": "", "writtenAt": "2026-08-29T07:01:54.915Z" } ``` | Symptom | Likely cause & fix | | --- | --- | | `403 FreeTierError` / "OpenCode's free tier can only be used from within OpenCode" | The upstream restricts free-tier clients. The plugin preserves the explanation instead of reporting an invalid API key. Use the supported OpenCode client or an official API service. | | Boot screen shows `Failed to load plugins … list slot "plugins.item" requires options.id`, or the IP 池 entry has no configuration page | Your DSH predates the 0.1.7 Plugins page contract. Upgrade DSH to 0.1.7 (latest recommended). On 0.1.6 and older the page never mounts (it is gated on `configForms.whileServed`) — model routing is unaffected. | | DSH 0.1.7/0.2 cannot start after plugin installation (`pending … settingsScope`) | Upgrade the plugin to 0.3.5. On DSH 0.2, configure IP pooling through the installed opencode2dsh row on the Plugins page. | | Only 3 models | Startup fetch raced your network; retries land within ~1 min. Check `adapter-status.json` for `lastError`. | | `lastError: "fetch failed"` persisting | Outbound HTTPS to `opencode.ai` blocked; check proxy/VPN rules. | | Rate-limit errors in chat (`429 … Endpoint is unavailable`) | The anonymous lane is quota-per-IP and free models are contended. Since the fix for [#51](https://github.com/FishBottle7/opencode2dsh/issues/51) the plugin's provider retry policy rides out 429 bursts silently (8 retries, ~1s→20s backoff, ≈90s worst case per step) instead of sur

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-knowledge-base · DSH 资料库

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的**本地 Markdown 资料库**插件：一边是给人看的可浏览面板，一边是给会话用的检索工具。

| 半边 | 文件 | 能力 |
|---|---|---|
| Host | `lib/index.js` | `node:fs` 读写 `$DSH_HOME/knowledge-base/`；`webServer` 开同源 HTTP 路由；向 `ctx.tools` 注册 **`kb_search` / `kb_read`** 两个 Agent 工具 |
| Browser | `lib/client.js` | `__ModuleLoader__` 装载；侧边栏「资料库」入口 + 中栏面板（搜索 / 分类树 / Markdown 阅读 / 在线编辑） |

## 安装

```sh
# 推荐：按 tag 从仓库安装（锁定到具体提交，可重复安装与升级）
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add "github:gaoheng980610/dsh-knowledge-base#v0.1.1"
```

也可以装 Release 里的预构建压缩包：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add "https://github.com/gaoheng980610/dsh-knowledge-base/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-knowledge-base-0.1.1.tgz"
```

> 压缩包直链在 pnpm 11 上有已知问题：**第一次安装正常，再次安装/升级同一链接**会报
> `ERR_PNPM_MISSING_TARBALL_INTEGRITY`（store 里已有该包，但 lockfile 条目没有 integrity 字段）。
> 需要重复安装或升级的，用上面的 `github:` 方式。

`dsh plugin add` 会同时把 `dsh-knowledge-base` 写进 profile `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles`；
装完**重启 DeepSeek Harness**——profile 的 bundle roster 在宿主进程启动时装载，
宿主半边（HTTP 路由 + Agent 工具）与浏览器半边都要重启后才生效。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-knowledge-base`（若 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中仍留有该行，一并删掉）。

从源码改动迭代时可以用 link 方式安装（改完即时生效，仍需重启）：

```powershell
cd $env:DSH_HOME\profiles\<profile>
node <pnpm.mjs> add link:<本包路径>
```

## 为什么这样做

DSH 里**唯一跨会话可见且可检索**的载体是「技能目录 + 插件工具」。本插件把资料库做成插件，
于是同一份内容有两条取用通道：

- **会话**：任何会话都能调 `kb_search` / `kb_read`，按需取用，不用把资料塞进上下文
- **人**：GUI 侧边栏「资料库」面板，可搜索、阅读、在线新建/编辑

## 数据布局

```
$DSH_HOME/knowledge-base/          （默认 ~/.dsh/knowledge-base/）
  <分类>/<名称>.md                  ← 目录即分类；id = 相对路径去掉 .md
  .trash/                           ← 删除的资料（可恢复）
```

文件头支持 YAML frontmatter（`title` / `tags` / `category` / `updated` / `source`），
没有也能用（标题取文件名）。

**插件本体不含任何资料内容**：安装后资料目录是空的，资料由你自己写进去，只存在本机。

## Agent 工具

| 工具 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `kb_search` | `{ query?, limit? }`。`query` 空格分词，**需全部命中**；**不传 query = 列出全部资料目录** |
| `kb_read` | `{ id }`。返回该资料全文 Markdown |

## HTTP 端点（浏览器半边用）

前缀 `/knowledge-base`，均 POST + JSON：

| 端点 | 入参 | 返回 |
|---|---|---|
| `list` | — | `{ ok, root, entries[] }`（**不含正文**） |
| `read` | `{ id }` | `{ ok, entry }`（含正文） |
| `save` | `{ id?, title, tags, body, category? }` | `{ ok, id }`；`id` 省略时按 `分类/标题` 新建 |
| `delete` | `{ id }` | `{ ok, id }`（移入 `.trash`） |
| `search` | `{ q, limit? }` | `{ ok, hits[] }`（按标题/正文计分，带摘要） |
| `stats` | — | `{ ok, total, categories, latest[] }` |

## 开发与自测

```bash
node --check lib/index.js
node --check lib/client.js
node test/smoke.mjs          # 离线冒烟：假 ctx/window/react 驱动两半边，36 项断言
```

`test/smoke.mjs` 不需要 DSH 就能跑，覆盖：路由全端点、frontmatter 读写、
全文搜索与计分、**路径穿越防护**、`.trash` 删除、两个 Agent 工具、
浏览器半边的槽注册与面板渲染。

## 踩坑记录（cordis · 勿回退）

### 1. 没在 `inject` 里声明的服务，属性访问会**直接抛异常**

```js
export const inject = ['webServer']    // 只声明了 webServer
const tools = ctx.tools                // ❌ Error: cannot get property "tools" without inject
```

**致命之处**：`apply()` 抛异常会让 cordis 把该 fiber 的**全部 effect 回滚**——
包括**已经注册成功的 HTTP 路由**。现象极具迷惑性：

- 浏览器半边独立加载 → 侧边栏「资料库」入口与面板**正常显示**
- 但所有接口返回 **405**（落到静态处理器），面板提示"无法连接 Host 半边"

修复：用到的服务都写进 `inject`；可选能力一律 `try/catch` 兜底。

### 2. `inject` 只支持**数组**形式

```js
export const inject = { required: ['webServer'], optional: ['tools'] }   // ❌
// 现象：插件停在 pending (waiting for services: required, optional)
```

对象形式不被该 cordis 版本支持——键名会被当成**服务名**去等待。只用数组：

```js
export const inject = ['webServer', 'tools']
```

### 3. 排查姿势：**一定要看宿主启动输出**

未激活的插件会写在启动输出里：

```
dsh: warning: 1 entry did not activate
ui-knowledge-base (dsh-knowledge-base): Error: cannot get property "tools" without inject
```

**快速迭代环境**（不必反复重启正在用的实例）：复制一份 profile，`node_modules`
用 junction 复用，换端口起独立实例：

```powershell
# profiles\kb-verify\package.json ← 复制 desktop；node_modules ← junction 到 desktop\node_modules
dsh --profile kb-verify --port 19997 --no-open --host 127.0.0.1
# 注意：语法是 dsh --profile <name> <app参数>，不要写成 dsh --profile x web
```

之后直接用 HTTP 打端点验证。用完记得先解除 junction 再删目录，避免误删 desktop 的 node_modules。

## 安全边界

- 所有 id 经 `idToPath()` 归一化并拒绝 `..` / 绝对路径 / 非 `.md`，**不能越出资料根目录**
- 正文单份上限 4MB；`list` 不返回正文，避免把整个资料库灌进上下文
- `delete` 是软删除（移入 `.trash`），可手工恢复
- 插件不引入任何第三方依赖（浏览器半边只用宿主内置的 `react`）
- 资料只在本机读写，插件不发起任何外部网络请求

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness 用量看板：账户余额、Token 使用量与三档成本拆分，含整年热力图与分组趋势曲线。Fork of lyk308/dsh-token-dashboard with dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 fixes.
plugins.readme_text: # dsh-token-dashboard DeepSeek Harness 的用量看板：把**账户余额**、**Token 使用量**和**花费**放在一个页面里，按天、按模型、按工作区看清钱花在哪。 数据全部来自本地 —— 会话日志 + DeepSeek 官方余额接口，不需要额外的云端账号。 ## 功能 ### 余额 实时账户余额，走 DeepSeek 官方接口，自动识别 CNY / USD，可强制刷新。 ### 用量 三张数字卡：**今日、近 7 天、近 30 天**（滚动窗口，含今天往前数）。加请求数、缓存命中率、会话数。顶部可切换全局时间范围：近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部，同步改变所显示的图表和分布。 ### 花费 按 DeepSeek 的三档计费**分别算出金额**：缓存命中输入、缓存未命中输入、输出。 计费口径： - **峰谷价**：峰谷定价按照 DeepSeek 官网明示为基准。判断按事件自身的发生时间，因此不随查看时间或设备时区变化，但除周末外的法定节假日谷期定价尚未实现。 - **按日期分档计价**：DeepSeek 每次调价记为一个新档位，事件用**它自己那天生效的单价**计算。所以后来调价不会改写之前几天的金额。 - **实际为估算**：插件只读取会话日志里的 token 数，再乘自己的价目表，并不知道 DeepSeek 实际扣了多少。对账请以官方账单为准。 - **未知模型**会被按 Flash 档计价，并在 `/api/token-dashboard/stats` 的 `unpricedModels` 里列出，以免静默算错。 改价：编辑 `lib/index.js` 里的 `PRICE_TIERS`，新增一条 `{ from: "YYYY-MM-DD", models: { ... } }` 即可；不同时段的单价写成 `[高峰, 空闲]` 两个数。官方价目见 [DeepSeek 定价页](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/quick_start/pricing)，发布日期见[更新日志](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/updates)。`PRICING_GAPS` 记录了表里哪些数字不是官方来源。 ### 分布与趋势 「用量分布」可切换**按模型 / 按工作区**，以及**按 Token / 按成本**，配占比条。每种分组各由一条**每日曲线**看出大致各自用量。 ### 活跃度 整年热力图（53 周 × 7 天）。悬停可显示当天日期、Token 与花费。 下面这张图同时能看到分工作区曲线和整年热力图： ### 明细与导出 按模型明细表（请求数 + 三档花费）、最近会话列表，以及一键导出 CSV / JSON。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile add @astralux/dsh-token-dashboard ``` 装完**刷新**，看板出现在 **设置 → 用量看板**。 也可以从 GitHub 或本地目录安装： ```bash dsh plugin --profile add github:LynnChrysteiin/dsh-token-dashboard dsh plugin --profile add /本仓库的绝对路径 ``` ## 使用 1. 打开 **设置 → 用量看板**。 2. 顶部选时间范围（近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部）。 3. 在「用量分布」里切换按模型 / 按工作区、按 Token / 按成本。 4. 鼠标移到热力图格子上看某一天的具体用量。 5. 需要留档就点「导出 CSV / 导出 JSON」。 ## 配置 不用配置即可使用。想改的话，host 部分在 `lib/index.js` 里读这几个值： | 项 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `sessionsRoot` | `$DSH_HOME/sessions` | 会话日志目录 | | `balanceCacheMs` | `300000` | 余额缓存时长（5 分钟） | | `sweepIntervalMs` | `60000` | 统计刷新间隔 | 也可以在 profile 的 patch 里覆盖整个价目表（`config.priceTiers`，结构与 `PRICE_TIERS` 相同，格式不合法时整份忽略并记一条 warning，回落到内置表）。改价方式见上面「花费」一节。 ## 说明 - **金额是估算**：插件只读会话日志里的 token 数，再乘自己的价目表，并不知道 DeepSeek 实际扣了多少。对账以官方账单为准。 - **余额显示「未配置 DeepSeek API Key」**：说明你用的是账号态登录而不是 API Key。余额卡片会空着，**Token 与花费统计不受影响**（它们来自本地会话日志）。 - **没有构建步骤**：纯 JavaScript，无依赖。改 `lib/client.js` 刷新页面即可，改 `lib/index.js` 需要重启 DSH。 ## 来源 Fork 自 [lyk308/dsh-token-dashboard](https://github.com/lyk308/dsh-token-dashboard)，MIT 许可，原作者 [@lyk308](https://github.com/lyk308)。本仓库在其基础上修好了 dsh 0.2.0-rc.2 的兼容问题（原版在这个版本上所有数字都读成 0），修正了按官方价目计价，并做了上面这些扩展。 ## 许可证 [MIT](./LICENSE)

plugins.description: Cloud speech recognizers for the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker (Volcengine Doubao), with an optional LLM tidy-up pass. · 给 DeepSeek Harness 的语音输入加豆包云端识别，可选再用大模型把口语顺成通顺的书面句子。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-voice-doubao · 豆包语音输入

**English** · **[中文](#中文)**

A cloud speech recognizer for the DeepSeek Harness voice-input picker, backed by Volcengine's **Doubao (豆包)** speech service.

![The voice-input settings page in DeepSeek Harness: the recognizer dropdown is set to "豆包听写 + 顺稿（云端）", and both Doubao entries below report 云端语音识别已就绪](assets/voice-input-config.png)

*Where they turn up — **Settings → Plugins → Voice input → Config**. Both entries registered and ready.*
*它们出现的地方——**设置 → 插件 → 语音输入 → 配置**。两条都已注册并就绪。*

---

# English

## Why this exists

DeepSeek Harness already ships a voice input, and it is good: it bundles a local SenseVoice model that runs offline, puts a microphone next to the composer, and drops the words into the box. It costs nothing and it asks nothing of you.

But I talk the way people actually talk. So I'd hold the button, say something perfectly sensible, and get back a transcript with three "那个" in it and no punctuation anywhere. The words were right. The sentence wasn't.

So this plugin adds entries to the *same* recognizer picker, pointing at Doubao's cloud models instead. Nothing else about the interface changes.

## What you get

| In the picker | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| **豆包听写（云端）** | Recognition, plus the service's own filler cleanup — the "嗯 / 那个 / 就是说" leave before you ever see them |
| **豆包听写 + 顺稿（云端）** | Hands that transcript to an LLM, which puts the sentence back together: punctuation, homophones, half-finished clauses joined up |

The second entry only appears if you configure a Volcengine **Ark** key. If you haven't, the plugin does not show it at all — a button that quietly does nothing is worse than no button.

Same nine-second recording, both paths, real output:

```
raw    ：那个就是我想说一下，我们是不是应该把这个语音识别的接口先接上，然后再说后面的事情？
tidied ：我想说一下，我们是不是应该把这个语音识别的接口先接上，再说后面的事情？
```

## What it costs

| Service | Price | Free tier |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 录音文件识别模型 2.0 — the default path | 0.8 元 / hour | 20 h, half a year |
| 豆包流式语音识别模型 2.0 — short clips | 1 元 / hour | 20 h, half a year |
| 火山方舟 — the optional tidy-up | ≈0.06 分 per call | — |

**A hundred ten-second sentences ≈ 0.22 元.** The free tier is claimed by hand: open the speech console, find the model, click 【试用】. Each recognizer has its own 20 hours.

⚠️ One trap worth knowing in advance: when you activate, choose the **hourly / pay-as-you-go** option. The *concurrency* SKU is sold per concurrent stream (¥500 per stream per month, default zero), and your first request will fail with `quota exceeded for types: concurrency`. That one cost me an evening.

## Install

**Route A — double-click.** Unzip somewhere permanent, then double-click `安装.cmd`. It finds the Node that ships with DeepSeek Harness and does the rest.

**Route B — command line.**

```powershell
$node = "$env:LOCALAPPDATA\Programs\DeepSeek Harness\resources\runtime\primary-runtime\dependencies\node\bin\node.exe"
& $node install.mjs
```

**Route C — the plugin manager.** DSH's plugin manager accepts a local **absolute path** (there is no drag-and-drop). Paste the unzipped folder path into its install box.

A and B create a directory link and edit the profile manifest — no package manager involved. C goes through pnpm. If pnpm has ever failed on your machine, prefer A or B.

Then: put your API key in `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\voice-doubao.json`, restart DeepSeek Harness, and run the doctor:

```powershell
& $node doctor.mjs
```

It ends with `15 项正常，全部就绪` when everything is in place, and every line marked `✗` comes with what to do about it.

> The unzipped folder **must not be moved or deleted afterwards** — DSH reaches the plugin through a link into it.

## Why it isn't slow (and where it can't be fast)

Two services sit behind this plugin, and they behave differently, so it picks per recording — measured against the real API, three runs each, alternating order:

| Recording | Submit + poll | Streaming | Winner |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4.3 s | 1234 ms | **1174 ms** | streaming, barely |
| 9.1 s | 2343 ms | **1714 ms** | streaming, by 27% |
| 21.0 s | **3187 ms** | 3462 ms | submit, barely |
| 43.1 s | **4150 ms** | 7619 ms | **submit, by 84%** |

The crossover is around 15 seconds, so the default `transport: "auto"` sends short clips to streaming and long ones down the submit path. On the same set of recordings:

| Recording | submit only | auto |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 4.3 s | 1.28 s | **0.87 s** |
| 9.1 s | 2.44 s | **1.37 s** |
| 43 s | 4.15 s | 4.36 s |

You can force either one with `transport: "submit"` or `"stream"`.

**The part I cannot fix:** the Doubao phone app feels instantaneous because it prints words *while you speak*. DSH's voice-input service exposes exactly one operation — "here is a finished recording, give me the text" — so the text can only appear after you let go. Inside that constraint this plugin waits roughly a second for a short sentence, and about four for a forty-second one.

## How to tell it is really being used

`doctor.mjs` answers this directly, from a status file the plugin keeps live:

```
✓ 当前选中的识别器就是豆包　现在选的是 doubao-polished
· 最近一次识别　2026/10/14 22:20:31　doubao-polished 处理，3.2s 音频 → 17 字，1.9s，顺稿已生效
```

That second line is a record of your last recording — which recognizer handled it, how long the audio was, and whether the tidy-up pass ran. The transcript text itself is **not** written to disk unless you set `logTranscripts`.

## Honest limits

- **You need your own API key.** This repository ships none and never will.
- **The tidy-up pass needs a second, separate key** from Volcengine Ark — different console, different service, different bill. It is optional; recognition works without it.
- **You have to pick the recognizer yourself** in *Settings → Plugins → Voice input → Config*. The microphone button starts recording immediately and never opens a menu. That surprised me too.
- **The catalog is a curated list.** DSH's plugin market only installs from it, so this plugin has to be listed before it can be installed from inside the app. Until then, the zip and this repository are the way in.
- Two Windows batch files are included for the double-click install. The plugin code itself is platform-neutral; only those two helpers are Windows-only.
- Windows users editing `package.json` in Notepad: the installer tolerates a UTF-8 BOM, because I hit that myself.

## Verified

- **168 offline tests**, run on Node 22 and Node 24 — WAV contract, protocol framing, transport selection, failure classification, cancellation, concurrency, the tidy-up guardrail, fallbacks, config layering, live status file.
- **Real-service runs** for both transports and both recognizers, against live Doubao and live Ark, with the raw output above.
- **56 more checks against the real runtime** — 22 against the real Cordis 4.0.4 service, 13 through the real plugin loader (so "it mounts after a restart" is tested rather than assumed), and 21 over the tidy-up prompt's actual output.
- The market's own requirements are met: `dsh.bundle` declared, `cordis.patch.yml` present, no `private` field, `.cmd` files stored as CRLF (verified byte-for-byte in the git object, so a downloaded ZIP still double-clicks).

Details — including the three problems only the live service could reveal (the streaming audio-format declaration, the silence diagnostic that pointed at the wrong thing, and a flagship model that wasn't activated) and how the transport numbers were taken — are in **[技术说明.md](技术说明.md)**.

## Repository layout

```
lib/                  the plugin: config, two transports, the tidy-up pass
test/                 offline suite + a mock service + a live check + a benchmark
install.mjs           link the plugin into a profile and register it
doctor.mjs            read-only health check: what's missing and what to do
probe-resources.mjs   which Volcengine speech resources your key can actually use
使用说明.md            step-by-step guide in Chinese
技术说明.md            engineering deep-dive: protocol, pitfalls, measurements
```

## License

MIT.

plugins.description: 抓虾浏览器插件｜DeepSeek Harness（DSH）API 优先网页自动化、实时预览、人工接管、上传下载、业务核验与可复用工作流，独立运行无需抓虾后端。
plugins.readme_text: # 抓虾浏览器插件 · DeepSeek Harness（DSH） **简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) 面向 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的独立浏览器自动化插件，提供网页操作、实时预览、 多标签页、人工接管和电商页面脚本执行。内置抓虾浏览器 Skill，帮助 Agent 按 “观察 → API 优先执行 → 业务核验 → 流程沉淀”完成采集、填表、上传下载和多阶段任务。 可独立运行，所需环境为 DSH、Node.js 和 Chrome/Chromium；无需抓虾后端。 这是社区插件，由 `dsh-crawshrimp-browser` 单个包提供工具、预览面板、Skill 和抓虾官方图标。 ## v0.3.0：API 优先的完整浏览器工作流 - **理解页面再执行**：探查 DOM、框架与端点线索，生成页面模型和策略 bundle。 - **API 优先**：页面模块/客户端调用、同源登录态请求；接口不明确时捕获真实网络证据，再回退 DOM。 - **上传下载**：工作区文件、文件选择器、认证 URL 和点击/blob 下载，返回大小、类型和 SHA-256 回执。 - **结构化核验**：DOM、数量、URL、API 业务字段和文件证据；保存脱敏 session journal。 - **流程复用**：从已验证步骤 distill workflow，或通过 adapter 草稿 → 隔离测试 → 本地发布复用复杂脚本。 - **阶段执行**：phase/page/shared、reload/abort、文件和网络动作，受阶段、分页、时间和输出上限约束。 [Harness 源码能力对照](docs/harness-parity.zh-CN.md) · [完整 Skill 与工具示例](skills/crawshrimp-browser/SKILL.md) ## 界面实测 ![DSH 抓虾浏览器实时预览：顶部多标签与实际商品页面](docs/screenshots/browser-v030-live.png) 实际 DSH Web 面板截图，使用本地合成商品页；[人工接管与中文输入效果](docs/screenshots/browser-v030-takeover.png)。 ## 快速开始 当前版本：[v0.3.0](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser/releases/tag/v0.3.0)。 适配 **DSH `0.2.1-alpha.4`**，Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`；请先安装 Chrome/Chromium。 使用 DSH 官方插件加载器安装到 Web profile： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser#v0.3.0 dsh --profile web ``` 在会话中让 Agent 加载 `crawshrimp-browser` Skill，再打开你指定的网页。 从右侧面板的新增/引导菜单选择“实时浏览器”，即可看到实际页面，网页标签横向排列在顶部。 需要人工登录或调整页面时，使用“接管操作”，完成后“恢复 Agent”。 ## 适用场景 - **网页自动化**：观察页面、按元素 ref 点击和填表，操作后再次核验结果。 - **电商页面数据采集**：读取商品表格，运行配置好的便携 JavaScript 脚本，校验参数并有界翻页。 - **可见的 Agent 协作**：实时查看网页、多标签切换，人工接管登录或操作，脚本页只读预览。 数据清洗和 CSV/Excel 导出使用[抓虾数据插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data)； Word/PowerPoint 文档使用[抓虾 Office 插件](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office)。 全部网页自动化集中在本浏览器插件中。 ## 能力 插件注册以下工具名： - `crawshrimp_browser_open`：在新的插件自有页面打开 `http` 或 `https` 地址。 - `crawshrimp_browser_pages`：只列出当前 DSH 会话拥有的页面。 - `crawshrimp_browser_navigate`：把自有页面导航到 `http` 或 `https` 地址。 - `crawshrimp_browser_observe`：返回有长度上限的正文和可操作元素引用。 - `crawshrimp_browser_click`：点击观察结果中的引用或 CSS 选择器。 - `crawshrimp_browser_fill`：向观察结果中的引用或 CSS 选择器填入文本。 - `crawshrimp_browser_select`：按 HTML option 的 `value` 选择选项。 - `crawshrimp_browser_press`：发送 Playwright 按键或 `Modifier+Key` 快捷键。 - `crawshrimp_browser_wait`：等待选择器可见/隐藏，或等待有长度上限的文本。 - `crawshrimp_browser_screenshot`：返回有大小上限的 PNG；纯观察不弹审批。 - `crawshrimp_browser_close`：关闭插件自有页面。 - `crawshrimp_browser_script_list`：发现便携的抓虾脚本适配器。 - `crawshrimp_browser_script_validate`：离线校验任务和参数，不请求审批或启动浏览器。 - `crawshrimp_browser_script_run`：在新建的隔离上下文执行任务脚本并保存 JSON artifact。 新增工具： | 工具后缀（完整前缀 `crawshrimp_browser_`） | 用途 | | --- | --- | | probe | 页面/框架/端点探查与策略 bundle | | evaluate / request | 有审批的页面 JS / 同源登录态 API 请求 | | capture_requests | 有界网络证据，可选 reload/click/scroll 触发 | | upload / download | 工作区文件上传下载与回执 | | verify / journal | 结构化核验与当前会话证据日志 | | workflow | 成功步骤沉淀和显式复用 | | adapter | 草稿、隔离测试、原样本地发布 | 打开、导航、点击、填充、选择、按键、关闭和脚本执行遵循 DSH 原生权限。 选择“完全权限”（`danger-full-access` + `never`）后自动执行，不再额外弹审批。 其他权限组合仍走 DSH 原生审批；单独的 `never` 不代表允许。列页面、观察、等待、截图是只读工具，不弹审批。没有审批服务时会 fail closed； 是否允许调用由 DSH 原生审批策略决定。取消调用会关闭该会话拥有的页面和上下文； 不确定的动作不会自动重试。观察得到的 ref 只在当前 observation 轮次有效，页面更新 或重新观察后应重新获取 ref。 脚本运行遵循相同原生权限映射，并复用插件已经建立的浏览器连接；每次运行都会创建 只属于该运行的新 BrowserContext 和页面，不会使用交互式 DSH 页面。脚本校验是离线的。 脚本支持有上限的翻页以及抓虾兼容的参数、shared-state 全局变量；不支持的后端专用动作和调度声明会被拒绝；受控的文件与网络动作通过同包能力执行。 ## 内置抓虾 Skill 同包注册 **crawshrimp-browser** 到 DSH 原生 Skill 目录，Agent 可通过 `skill` 工具加载，也可从技能菜单选择。内容覆盖“观察 → API 优先 → 核验 → 沉淀”、网络探查、上传下载、人工登录接管 和便携脚本复用，只使用本插件工具，不需要单独安装或抓虾后端。最小 CLI 组合没有 Skill 服务时，全部浏览器工具仍可使用。 ## DSH Web 实时预览 同一个包内包含 DSH 客户端面板，通过 Chromium CDP 推送**实际 Playwright 页面的画面**，并提供有界截图回退。无需抓虾后端，也没有独立的预览项目。 1. 在 DSH **Web profile** 安装本插件，打开一个会话。 2. 让 Agent 调用 `crawshrimp_browser_open` 打开网页，或运行已配置的便携脚本。 3. 在右侧面板的新增/引导菜单选择**实时浏览器**。顶部横向网页标签只显示当前会话；开启“跟随最新页面”会自动选择新建页面。 4. 点击**接管操作**后，可以在交互页面点击、拖动、滚动、输入和粘贴。接管期间，该页面的 Agent 写操作会被拒绝；点击**恢复 Agent**归还控制。仅观看画面不会取得输入权。 5. 脚本运行页带有运行标识，支持只读观看；运行结束或取消后自动移除，交互页面仍保持独立。 面板使用 DSH 自带的停靠/浮动标签布局。切页、隐藏、失焦或断线会释放人工控制；重连只恢复观察。WebSocket 复用 DSH 宿主的 Host/Origin 检查和签名浏览器身份校验，仅接受 owner 身份。面板不会获得原始 CDP 地址或 storage-state 文件内容。 `previewEnabled` 默认 `true`，设为 `false` 可禁用预览注册。纯 CLI profile 保留全部工具；预览需要 Web profile 的原生 `connection` 和 `webServer` 服务，并仍需安装 Chrome/Chromium。[原实现审计与设计](docs/live-preview-architecture.zh-CN.md)记录了抽离依据和生命周期约定。 ## 浏览器前置条件 包内只包含 Playwright 驱动，不包含浏览器二进制文件。请在机器上安装 Chrome 或 Chromium，并配置 `executablePath` 或 `channel`。macOS 默认使用系统 Chrome （`channel: chrome`）；CI 如果没有 Chrome channel，可通过 `CHROME_PATH` 设置 `executablePath`。也可以设置 `cdpEndpoint`，但插件仍会创建自己的新上下文；卸载 时只断开连接，不关闭外部浏览器。 ## 使用 DSH 官方插件加载器安装 仓库按 GitHub 安装方式准备，没有假定已经发布 npm 包： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser#v0.3.0 ``` 本地验证： ```sh git clone https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-browser.git cd dsh-crawshrimp-browser npm ci dsh plugin --profile demo add -w . ``` 加载器会读取 `package.json` 中的 `dsh.bundle.patch`，并应用包内的 `cordis.patch.yml`。它生成的配置项等价于： ```yaml - id: crawshrimp-browser name: dsh-crawshrimp-browser config: channel: chrome headless: true adapterRoots: - /absolute/path/to/adapters workspaceDir: /absolute/path/to/dsh-crawshrimp-browser maxPages: 1 scriptTimeoutMs: 120000 maxScriptBytes: 524288 maxOutputBytes: 2097152 ``` 如需指定浏览器可执行文件，可在 profile overlay 中使用绝对路径： ```yaml - id: crawshrimp-browser name: dsh-crawshrimp-browser config: executablePath: !!js process.env.CHROME_PATH ?? '' channel: chrome headless: true ``` `executablePath` 优先于 `channel`；主机提供 Chromium 时可使用 `channel: chromium`。用户管理的 Chrome 可通过 `cdpEndpoint`（例如 `http://127.0.0.1:9222`）连接，但插件不会采用其中已有的上下文或页面。 需要人工登录时可以设置 `headless: false`，登录发生在插件自有的 DSH 会话上下文 中；会话结束时该上下文一并释放，插件不会加载或持久化共享的 Chrome 配置目录。 如果用户已经通过 Playwright 导出登录状态，可以把 `storageStatePath` 配置为私有的 JSON 文件路径。文件只读使用，必须是普通文件且不超过 5 MiB；每个新建的 DSH 会话 都会加载它： ```yaml - id: crawshrimp-browser name: dsh-crawshrimp-browser config: channel: chrome headless: true storageStatePath: /absolute/path/to/private/storage-state.json ``` 默认值为空。浏览器工具不会返回 cookie、token 或 storage state 内容。文件不存在、 不可读、超过大小限制或 JSON 格式错误时，会以明确错误拒绝创建会话。 ## 便携脚本适配器 每个适配器目录包含严格的 `manifest.yaml` 和一个或多个相对路径 `.js` 任务脚本。支持 的 manifest 字段包括 `id`、`name`、`version`、`description`、`author`、`entry_url`、 `skip_auth`、`trigger: { type: manual }` 和 `tasks`。任务可以覆盖 `entry_url`，并使用 `text`、`textarea`、`number`、`select`、`radio`、`checkbox` 或 `date` 声明 `params`。 文件、目录、模型链等后端专用控件会返回迁移诊断；不声明 `params` 的任务保持旧行为， 可以接收任意 JSON 对象。 任务脚本必须是返回 `{ success, data, meta }` 的 async IIFE。运行时把同一个 JSON-clone 对象注入 `window.__PARAMS__` 和 `window.__CRAWSHRIMP_PARAMS__`，并注入 `window.__CRAWSHRIMP_PAGE__`、`window.__CRAWSHRIMP_PHASE__` 和 `window.__CRAWSHRIMP_SHARED__`。返回 `meta.has_more: true` 会在同一页面再次执行，运行时 会传递 `meta.shared` 并合并 `data`。`maxPages` 范围为 1–100，单次运行可以用 `max_pages` 覆盖。支持 `next_phase`、`reload_page`、`abort` 和受控文件/网络动作；每页阶段默认最多 20 次，单次可用 `max_phases` 调整，上限 200。详见[阶段协议](skills/crawshrimp-browser/references/runtime.md)。 可以从[示例适配器](examples/demo-adapter)开始，并使用 `node examples/save-storage-state.js` 辅助程序保存登录状态。storage-state 文件应保存在 私有目录，不要提交到源码仓库。 ## 开发验证 ```sh npm ci npm run check npm test npm pack --dry-run ``` 测试会启动真实的无头 Chrome，并访问本地合成页面；不会访问真实电商站点或账号。 可用 `CHROME_PATH` 覆盖测试使用的 Chrome 路径。 ## 功能划分与迁移 浏览器包统一负责全部网页工作，包含便携页面脚本。[数据包](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-data)负责记录/表格清洗，[Office 包](https://github.com/howtimeschange/dsh-crawshrimp-office)负责文档。三个包均可独立运行。 原 Scripts 用户请按[迁移指南](docs/migration-from-scripts.md)升级。[功能划分](docs/functional-map.zh-CN.md)记录了早期路线图；v0.3.0 已在 Browser 中提供页面探查、网络证据和上传下载，最新状态以[源码能力对照](docs/harness-parity.zh-CN.md)为准。 0.2.0 增加内置抓虾 Skill、完全权限自动执行、顶部标签实时预览/人工接管、页面管理、导航、下拉选择、按键、等待、显式登录态，以及合并后的脚本校验、参数和有界翻页能力。 0.2.1 统一封装抓虾官方图标，并用于 DSH 插件卡片、实时浏览器标签和引导入口。

plugins.description: Per-turn skill audit for DeepSeek Harness plus an in-app skill manager. Fork of dsh-echocat-skill-panel with the composer strip removed.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-useof-skill-panel

> **本仓库是 [`dsh-echocat-skill-panel`](https://github.com/VDERR/dsh-echocat-skill-panel) 的 fork，署名与出处保留。**
> 与原版**同时安装**、互不干扰，功能上唯一的区别是**删掉了输入框上方那条摘要横栏**（`conversation.input.dock`）——
> 组件与注册一并删除，所以那条横栏根本不会被挂载。
> 面板、侧边栏入口、装卸面板、背景/主题、宿主侧全部与原版逐字一致。
>
> 代价只有一个：原横栏是唯一能往输入框里插入 `/技能名` 的位置，所以**一键插入技能名的功能没有了**。
> 要看那条横栏，启用原版（`dsh-echocat-skill-panel@5.1.3`）即可 —— 两个插件可以并存。

**v5.1.4** · DSH Desktop Beta 的 cordis 插件：统计每轮对话用到了哪些 skill，并让你**在应用里直接装卸、更新它们**。

判定不依赖模型自觉 —— 插件从会话事件流推导本轮调了哪些 skill（模型自动、你手动 `/name`、或一个都没用），模型忘了说也照样报。

![面板](docs/panel.png)

两个界面共用一份数据：

| 位置 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| **左栏图标** | 常驻入口，点它在中间打开面板（`sidebar.panellist`，order 60） |
| **中栏面板** | 完整报告 + skill 目录（`main`） |

> 与原版的可视差异：本 fork 只注册上面两个座位。原版的第三个座位——输入框上方的摘要横栏——已整体移除。

## 一键安装

把作者给的地址**整个粘进来**就行：

```
https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/main/skills/my-skill
```

仓库主页、仓库里的文件夹链接、`SKILL.md` 链接、zip 直链、`owner/repo`、SSH 地址都认 —— host 自己判断该克隆还是该下载，分支与子目录从地址里解析，不用你填三个框。也可以上传 `.md`/`.zip`，或直接粘贴整篇 `SKILL.md`。

同名不会静默覆盖：先备份再替换。装错了能删，**删掉的进备份目录，永不硬删**。

![安装面板](docs/install-sheet.png)

## 背景自定义（4.4）

面板可以有背景。报告右上角的「背景自定义」打开一张设置面板，**左侧是实时预览**，改一下看一眼，不满意随时取消 —— **预览、取消、恢复默认是三件不同的事**，不会"改了就算数"。

![背景自定义](docs/background-settings.png)

- **四类样式**：液态、柔和渐变、纯色、本地图片；**六套低饱和预设**（柔柔银蓝、珍珠白、紫棠、暖砂灰、深色金属、青瓷）直接挑一个开始。
- **每个滑块都真的作用于背景**：主色 / 辅助色 / 高光色，明暗、亮度、饱和度、对比、金属高光、柔化、遮罩、速度、形变、指针反馈 —— 而**不适用的选项会隐藏**，不是摆在那里让你调了没反应。
- **图片在本机处理**：接受 JPG/PNG/WebP（上限 8 MB），**在本机缩到长边 1920 以内**，支持铺满裁切 / 完整显示 / 拉伸与位置。图片和设置**单独存在客户端数据库里，不上传、不改动 skill 数据、不碰宿主配置**。
- **只影响当前客户端**：设置跨本插件的各个表面共享、刷新后保留，但**不宣称跨设备同步** —— 因为它确实不跨。
- 静态模式下背景**不持续渲染**；隐藏、卸载和系统"减少动态"仍然照常生效。

## 装了之后能更新（4.0）

**问题**：3.0 把地址用一次就丢了（git 克隆还会被删掉）。作者发了修复，你无从判断新旧，只能删了重装 —— 而删除是移动到备份。

**做法**：安装时把来源写进该 skill 自己的 `.echocat.json`：地址、分支、子目录、**安装时的 commit**、以及一份**内容指纹**。于是：

- 卡片上多一行来源。远端有新 commit 时标成「**可更新**」，点两下即替换，**旧版本先进备份**。
- 判断只跑一次 `git ls-remote`，**不重新下载内容**；来源固定在某 commit 上时不会被误报成"有新版"。
- **你手改过这个 skill 的文件**时，确认文案会明说"更新会覆盖它们" —— 这是唯一会丢改动的场景。
- 手工装的、或 2.x/3.0 装的 skill 没有这条记录，卡片上给一个「标记来源」，填一次地址即纳入更新。
- 中文显示名不受影响：更新沿用你为该 skill 设的 `display-name-zh`。

## 界面

- **宽度跟着界面缩放**：面板的宽度由宿主自己的输入框宽度推导（`--dsh-composer-card-max-width` 减 16px），**永远比输入框窄**，并且和输入框共享同一条中轴 —— 宽窗口、窄窗口、嵌入式布局都对。
- **一套完整的设计语言**：四个表面台阶（画布 / 卡片 / 抬升 / 下沉）、一个强调色（靛蓝，只用于主操作、选中和"有东西可做"）、五级字阶（10.5 → 26px，字号越大字距越紧）、三级投影（每级两层低透明度叠加），发丝线用 `color-mix` 从墨色推导。
- **1006 条具名调整**：239 项行为打磨（[polish.js](src/client/polish.js)）+ 767 项设计重做（[design.js](src/client/design.js)），全部是带名字和理由的数据记录，样式表由它们生成，测试逐条核对真的生效。
- **插件自己也能检查更新**：面板头部有一组按钮 —— 「检查更新」问 npm 与 GitHub 谁更新（10 分钟缓存，只有点击才联网），旁边是 GitHub 发布页跳转。查到新版本时按钮带强调色和一个小圆点，头部还会直接写出「可更新 x.y.z」；"查不到"和"已是最新"是两句不同的话。
- **skill 名字一行显示全**：卡片是三行结构（名字行 / 说明 / 按钮行）。名字独占整行并且**会换行、不会被省略号截断** —— 之前它和六个按钮抢一行，长名字只剩几个字符加省略号。
- **每个 skill 一个开关**：停用会把目录**移出 DSH 监视的 skills 目录** —— 模型真的加载不到它，而文件一个不少，随时一键启用回来。已启用与已停用分两组列出，停用的卡片仍可改名、查来源、更新、删除。
- **深浅两套都验过**：深色盘同时挂在系统偏好与**应用内主题**两条信号上；所有文字色都按 WCAG 算过对比度（正文 18.2:1、次级 6.4:1、元数据 5.3:1）。
- `prefers-reduced-motion`、`prefers-reduced-transparency`、窄屏布局各自有覆盖。
- 改界面的做法：`node tools/preview.mjs` 渲染真实面板并截图，加 `--measure` 打印计算样式 —— **先看见，再改**。

> 原版横栏那一行的四个计数器，随横栏一起移除了；计数仍然在面板里。

## 中文显示

中文名写进该 skill 自己的 `meta.yaml`（`display-name-zh`），面板就按中文显示。安装时能填，装完在卡片上随时能改，留空则清除。

`/名字` 手势仍然走 ASCII 代号，两者互不干扰。

## 安装

**GitHub 源码**（拿到的是完整包）：

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Doctor-Pan-code/dsh-useof-skill-panel.git
cd dsh-useof-skill-panel
npm install            # 只装两个 optional peer，运行时并不需要
```

然后把仓库目录接进你的 profile（`<DSH_HOME>` 默认是 `~/.dsh`）：

```powershell
# 1) 在 <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<你的 profile>/package.json 的 dependencies 里加：
#      "dsh-useof-skill-panel": "link:<本仓库的绝对路径>"
# 2) 在同文件的 dsh.profile.bundles 数组里加：
#      "dsh-useof-skill-panel"
# 3) 再 pnpm install 一次
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 已经随包提供，bundles 里声明它就会自动挂载 —— 不需要手写 patch 行。

> 两个 `peerDependencies`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`、`@deepseek-ai/schemastery`）标了 `optional`：由 DSH 运行时提供，npm 不会自己去下载一份来顶替宿主的那份。

> **装完必须重启 DSH Desktop Beta。** host 半侧在 boot 时快照进内存，而客户端 bundle 每次开页面会重新拉取 —— 所以只改客户端刷新页面就够，**改了 host 必须重启**。

手动安装的四步、卸载回滚，以及**五条会让应用起不来的硬性约束**都在 [安装说明.md](安装说明.md)。

## 更多

每轮结束弹一次系统原生通知；给没中文的 skill 自动翻译并缓存；深色主题；宿主不允许写入时自动变只读并说明原因；全部配置项 —— 见 [安装说明.md](安装说明.md)。

架构与实现要点、安装引擎的四条安全规矩、**宽度为什么用百分比而不是像素**、**停用为什么是"移出目录"而不是改名**、**1006 条调整为什么是生成的**、**设计重做是怎么"先看见再改"的**、**来源记录为什么放在 skill 目录里**、**版本比较为什么不能拿字符串比**、**为什么"声明进了样式表"不等于"规则能命中元素"**（4.0.1 整页空白 bug 的教训）、**踩过的坑**（宿主语义令牌不能当视觉令牌用、逗号选择器不能共享组合符、`min-height:0` 会架空粘底页脚、CSS 注释里的反引号会截断样式表……）—— 见 [docs/设计要点.md](docs/设计要点.md)。

## 开发

```powershell
node tools/build-client.mjs        # 生成 lib/client.js（改了 src/client/ 就必须跑）
npm test                           # 十四个套件，1520 项断言
node tools/preview.mjs             # 渲染真实面板并截图（浅色 + 深色）
node tools/preview.mjs --measure   # 打印关键元素的计算样式
node tools/check-width-live.mjs    # 真 Chrome 量宽度（改了宽度规则就跑）
```

> `lib/client.js` 是**入库的构建产物**（目标机器没有工具链，`lib/` 必须一起提交）。**改了 `src/client/` 就要在同一个 commit 里重建它**，漏了 `test/client-bundle.mjs` 会在门里失败。

运行时没有任何依赖；`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` 与 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery` 是 host 提供的 peer。

## 相对上游的改动

本 fork 与 [`dsh-echocat-skill-panel@5.1.3`](https://github.com/VDERR/dsh-echocat-skill-panel) 的差异**只有一处功能改动**，为了能与原版同时安装，另有一组标识符改名：

| 项 | 上游 | 本 fork |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 座位 | 三个（含输入框上方横栏） | **两个**（`main` + `sidebar.panellist`） |
| 目录 / 包名 / bundle id | `dsh-echocat-skill-panel` | `dsh-useof-skill-panel` |
| loader entry id | `skill-report` | `skill-report-use` |
| 客户端面板 key | `skill-report` | `skill-report-use` |
| HTTP 路由 | `/api/skill-report/*` | `/api/skill-report-use/*` |
| CSS 标记 | `data-plugin="dsh-echocat-skill-panel"` | `data-plugin="dsh-useof-skill-panel"` |
| 状态目录 | `~/.dsh/skill-report/` | `~/.dsh/skill-report-use/` |

**保留上游原样**的两处：写在每个 skill 目录里的来源记录文件名 `.echocat.json`（它是数据格式不是身份标识，改名会让已装用户的历史记录失效），以及 `src/release.js` 里的版本检查地址（仍指向上游的 npm 包与 GitHub 发布页 —— 本 fork 未发布到 npm）。

## 许可

MIT，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。Copyright (c) 2026 dsh-skill-report contributors.

plugins.description: Time-shifting task delegation for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): plan tasks at leisure, they run unattended off-peak, come back to a report. Human-adjudicated, desktop + web.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-lowtide **Queue tasks when it's busy. They run on their own when it's cheap.** Semi-auto or full-auto, off the model's peak hours and peak prices. A must-have plugin for DeepSeek Harness. **English** | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md) | [繁體中文](./README.zh-HK.md) | [العربية](./docs/README.ar.md) | [Deutsch](./docs/README.de.md) | [Español](./docs/README.es.md) | [Français](./docs/README.fr.md) | [Italiano](./docs/README.it.md) | [한국어](./docs/README.ko.md)
--- ![hero](./assets/screenshots/hero.png)

Three tasks waiting in the queue, the price status glowing in the session header, auto-run when your window opens

## Introduction lowtide is a plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (dsh)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh). The problem it solves is plain and perfectly natural: Usually, when you want an agent to do some work, you sit at the computer, send the agent an instruction, wait for the reply, and then review it by hand. But this workflow seems to forget that you have plenty of idle time — and a chance to dodge the peak/off-peak pricing that some models charge. With lowtide installed, the day goes like this: whenever a job crosses your mind during the day, toss it in the queue, glance at it, release it. The tasks pile up until the time you set (say, after 7 PM — that's when DeepSeek is at valley pricing), then run by themselves. Next morning you open the report: keep what went well, send back what didn't. That's all it is. But use it for a week and your working rhythm genuinely slows down — and don't forget, "time is money, efficiency is life"... A few key capabilities: - Four execution strategies: single, iterative, sampling, review — from "one pass is enough" to "run five candidates and I'll pick" - 168 unit tests + 10 end-to-end specs, CI green across ubuntu / windows × node 22 / 24 - One build artifact serves both desktop and web — install once, works on both - Off-peak execution lands in DeepSeek's valley hours: the same batch costs about half of what peak would ## A normal day with an agent might look like this… **Ten minutes before clocking out.** You've finished reviewing code, so you file three tickets for tomorrow: a refactor (iterative, 3 rounds), a weekly report (single), and a design you're unsure about (sampling, 4 candidates). Release them all, shut down, leave. Tomorrow at your desk, the morning report says: the refactor's done, the report's drafted, and four candidate designs sit side by side, each with its cost written out. **Friday night.** Queue a week's worth of chores in one go: dependency cleanup, missing tests, data scripts. Weekends are valley price around the clock. You go out; it works from home. Monday you check the report — retry what failed, merge what's good. **A 10 AM brainwave.** You're mid-conversation with the agent about an urgent bug when you think "hey, update the docs too." The intercept card pops up: running now costs peak price, tonight it's about half — the difference is spelled out. Click "queue for off-peak"; your draft survives untouched, and you go back to the bug. **An always-on server.** You've got a machine running dsh 24/7. Switch to L3 full-auto, then file tasks from anywhere through the API (`POST /ds-lowtide/tasks`). It runs them on schedule and writes the report. Nobody's watching, but the sandbox, the daily budget, and the file locks are all still there. **Deliverables for a client.** Use the review strategy: run once, then automatically open an independent session that tears the result apart through your chosen focus (say, "hunt for data-source errors"). In the morning you don't get a bare result — you get a result plus a critical review. **Living abroad.** You're in San Francisco; DeepSeek's peak is Beijing time, which for you lands in the evening and night before. Settings converts the official hours to your local clock, one click to adopt. You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

You set windows by your own schedule, and the books always stay aligned with the official table. ## How lowtide works ``` ① Intake ② Adjudicate ③ Execute ④ Accept Whenever you have The queue dock When the off-peak When you're back: a moment: one-click groups tasks by window opens: five open the report — from the intercept workspace; triage preflight gates pass, results + diff card, or file a → line by line: → then sandboxed runs → + actual spend ticket (4 strategies) ✓approve ⏸defer one batch per window + money saved ✕drop / approve-all ``` A task's life: `pending-review → queued → preflight → running → done / failed / stale / timeout`, plus `deferred` (postponed) and `dropped` (soft-deleted, restorable). Step two is where lowtide differs from a "fully automated script": **every task must be released by your hand before it runs** (in L2, you release the whole batch at once, 30 minutes before the window). The machine cannot move itself into the run queue. Execution is automated; decisions are not. That's why you can safely be absent. ## A tour of the lowtide interface **The new-task modal.** Four strategies side by side, each with a plain-language hint; rounds, priority, and run mode ride along per task — no trip back to settings. Tasks land as "pending review". Nothing enters the queue without passing you. ![new-task-modal](./assets/screenshots/new-task-modal.png) **Advanced options.** Model, reasoning effort, priority from 0 to 9, fresh session or continue-previous, and the locked-files list — all in one small pane. Locked files, briefly: anything on the list gets sha256-checked before execution, and if it doesn't match what you filed, the task goes stale and refuses to run. Otherwise the file you queued against could be rewritten by another task while waiting, and this one would blindly stomp on it. ![advanced-options](./assets/screenshots/advanced-options.png) **Pick any model.** Batch runs default to the official `deepseek-flash` (DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash; the retired `deepseek-v4-flash` name still routes there at Flash prices), but each task can pick its own model — anything connected to your Harness is in the dropdown, grouped by provider. Private providers work too. Non-official models have no public price table, so the ledger honestly says "price unknown"; add a price override in settings if you want the bookkeeping exact. ![model-picker](./assets/screenshots/model-picker.png) **The window editor.** Multi-segment, overnight, per-weekday — all fine. Underneath is a live 24-hour price band: red for peak, green for valley, and a marker showing where you are right now. Outside UTC+8, one click on "adopt official peak hours" converts Beijing time to your local clock. ![window-editor](./assets/screenshots/window-editor.png) **The settings page.** Window hours, tasks per batch, per-task duration cap, concurrency, daily budget, report history, autonomy level, price overrides — all graphical, no config files. The official pricing rules (including the new all-weekend valley) are explained in human language on the same page. ![settings](./assets/screenshots/settings.png) Three more pieces of UI appear in daily use: the **price pill** (session header — busy/idle, queue size; click it to edit windows), the **peak-hours intercept card** (type at peak, it appears; the price difference is spelled out; your draft survives), and the **execution report** (the morning briefing: savings first, anomalies pinned, candidates awaiting your pick, one-click Markdown copy). ## About lowtide workspaces Every task runs inside a workspace. That single dropdown decides three things. **Which files it can touch.** Tasks run in a sandbox whose boundary is the workspace directory. Pick wrong and at best it can't find the files; at worst it edits something it shouldn't. **Who it queues with.** Tasks in the same workspace run serially (two tasks never fight over one repo); different workspaces run in paralle

# dsh-pet-company

安静一点的桌面陪伴：坐久了起来走走，水杯空了续一下，深夜了早点收工。三套随包 Q 版角色，默认安静，其余时间陪你慢慢写代码。

English: a calm desktop companion plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It ships three chibi characters and quiet break / water / long-session / late-night reminders, with cloud bubbles and a light bounce. Source code is MIT; the bundled character art is CC BY-NC 4.0 (attribution, non-commercial). Verified with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2 / DSH Desktop 2.0.17 on macOS arm64; Windows and Linux are untested.

![银白龙娘、橙书娘与蓝鲸女仆三套 Q 版角色预览](assets/characters/preview.png)

## 截图

![「设置 → 陪伴」面板](docs/screenshots/settings-companion.png)

![页面内角色与云朵气泡](docs/screenshots/pet-tide-bubble.png)

## 它会做什么

- 久坐、喝水、连续工作和深夜关怀四类提醒，可分别关闭；默认安静档每小时最多一句。
- 审批或提问等待期间保持安静；断线、目标切换和冷却期不积压、不补发关怀。
- 新装默认内置模式，只显示一只银白；银白、橙书娘、蓝鲸女仆可随时切换。
- 内置模式随包提供三套透明动画、云朵气泡、等比轻回弹和派生播放器，不再需要手工替换原版 dsh-pet 文件。
- 可选外部模式：同一 Profile 已安装并启用原版 dsh-pet 时，只向它发送基础关怀，不接管其窗口、配置或资源。
- 「设置 → 陪伴」管理模式、角色、显示位置、外观、提醒频率与静默时段；「试说一句」会真实显示一条关怀。

本插件不调用模型、不读取键盘输入，也不采集健康数据。桌面窗口是独立命名、独立数据目录的 Electron helper；缺少运行时时设置仍可用，只有明确点击并同意后才会下载。

## 安装

当前版本 **0.2.0**，适配 DSH 0.2.0-rc.x（实测 0.2.0-rc.2 / DSH Desktop 2.0.17），Node.js 22.13+。

**方式一：dshmarket（推荐）**

打开 DSH Desktop → 设置 → 插件市场（dshmarket），搜索 `dsh-pet-company`，点击安装并按提示重启当前 Profile。目录收录正在审核，合并后市场会自动同步；如果暂时搜不到，使用方式二。

**方式二：GitHub Release**

Web profile 或自定义 profile 可直接安装预构建 tarball：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 Profile> add https://github.com/Oliveryfaso/dsh-pet-company/releases/download/v0.2.0/dsh-pet-company-0.2.0.tgz
dsh --profile <你的 Profile>
```

Desktop 用户在应用自己的「设置 → 插件」入口填写同一个 tarball 地址；普通 npm CLI 不能管理 Desktop 保留的 `desktop` Profile。完整步骤、升级、卸载与回退见 [安装说明](docs/INSTALL.md)。

**显示位置**

- **DSH 页面内**：角色显示在 DSH 页面右下角，不需要独立 Electron；本项目目前在 macOS 上实测，其他平台未验证。
- **桌面窗口**：独立透明置顶窗口，需要 macOS arm64 和官方 Electron 43.3.0；首次在设置里点击下载并确认。
- **暂不显示**：保留提醒调度和全部设置。

新装默认「桌面窗口」。没有独立运行时不会自动下载，设置页会说明原因，其他设置仍可修改保存。

## 第一次使用

1. 重启 Profile 后打开「设置 → 陪伴」，确认状态为「桌宠已连接」。
2. 选择「内置形象」与「显示位置」。想跳过 Electron 下载时，先选「DSH 页面内」并保存。
3. 点击宠物可看到云朵气泡；「试说一句」会发送一条真实关怀（每分钟最多一次）。
4. 外部模式需要先在同一个 Profile 安装并启用 [dsh-pet](https://github.com/PC2005-cloud/dsh-pet)，再把「陪伴模式」切换为外部。

| 角色 | 内置 ID | 默认待机 |
|---|---|---|
| 银白龙娘 | `companion-silver` | 源 idle |
